query:
WITH MarriedMen AS (
  SELECT 
    hl.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS total_married_men,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.marital_status = 'متزوج' THEN d.id END) AS married_to_one,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.marital_status = 'زوجتين' THEN d.id END) AS married_to_two_or_more
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON d.id = hl.id
  WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح'
    AND d.gender = 'M'
    AND d.marital_status IN ('متزوج', 'زوجتين')
    AND TRIM(hl.region) != ''
    AND hl.district IS NOT NULL 
    AND hl.district NOT IN ('خارج حدود الاحياء', 'بدون اسم')
    AND hl.city != 'nan'
  GROUP BY hl.region
),
MarriageRatio AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    total_married_men,
    married_to_one,
    married_to_two_or_more,
    (married_to_two_or_more * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_married_men, 0)) AS polygamy_ratio
  FROM MarriedMen
)
SELECT 
  region AS Region,
  ROUND(polygamy_ratio, 2) AS Percentage
FROM MarriageRatio
ORDER BY polygamy_ratio DESC LIMIT 20000
